categories.name: Kinder
categories.desc: Lernspiele für die Kleinsten: Buchstaben, Zahlen, Musik.

categories.name: Retro-Konsolen
categories.desc: Klassische Konsolen: WASM-4-, Game-Boy-, Arduboy- und CHIP-8-Spiele, alle frei.

categories.name: Produktivität
categories.desc: Fokus-Timer, Dashboards und Werkzeuge für den Schreibtisch.

categories.name: Smart Home
categories.desc: Lichter, Steckdosen und Sensoren im Netzwerk steuern.

categories.name: Terminal
categories.desc: Programme für das Terminal: Lua, JavaScript, BASIC, SQLite, Textabenteuer.

apps.name: JavaScript
apps.author: QuickJS-ng project (Bellard, Gordon, contributors)
apps.description: Modernes JavaScript (ES2024) mit QuickJS-ng: interaktive Eingabe, Skripte und Module, Dateien, Timer. js oder js datei.js tippen.

apps.name: Lua
apps.author: Lua.org, PUC-Rio
apps.description: Lua 5.4 im Terminal: interaktive Eingabe und Skripte. lua tippen, oder lua script.lua fuer eine Datei aus /sdcard/home.

apps.name: SQLite
apps.author: SQLite developers (D. Richard Hipp et al.)
apps.description: Die SQLite-Shell: lokale SQL-Datenbanken auf der SD-Karte, mit JSON und Mathe-Funktionen. sqlite3 notizen.db tippen.

apps.name: ABC 123
apps.description: Lerne Buchstaben und Zahlen mit 7 Minispielen. Mehrsprachig, mit Stimme.

apps.name: Cannon
apps.description: Artillery arcade: drag your finger to set angle and power, lift it to fire.

apps.name: CHIP-8 Arcade
apps.author: NucleoOS; games by the CHIP-8 Community Archive authors
apps.description: 83 Homebrew-Spiele aus dem CHIP-8 Community Archive (CC0) in einer CHIP-8 / SUPER-CHIP / XO-CHIP Konsole.

apps.name: Devices
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Shelly, WLED und Tasmota im WLAN, automatisch gefunden: mit einem Tipp schalten. Ohne Home Assistant und Cloud.

apps.name: Doom Engine
apps.author: NucleoOS (doomgeneric, Chocolate Doom, emu8950)
apps.description: Die klassische Doom-Engine (doomgeneric, aus Chocolate Doom) für dieses Board: 4:3-Bild, OPL-Musik, Tastatur, Maus und Gamepads. Startet die Doom-Spiele aus dem Store und eigene WADs.

apps.name: Home
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Home Assistant auf dem Panel: Lichter, Steckdosen, Rollladen, Thermostate, Schlosser, Szenen und Sensoren nach Raum. URL und Token unter Einstellungen > Zuhause.

apps.name: openHASP
apps.author: openHASP contributors (HASwitchPlate)
apps.description: openHASP (HASwitchPlate): touch pages for Home Assistant described in JSONL and driven over MQTT. Works with the openHASP integration from HACS.

apps.name: Pianino
apps.description: Ein buntes Kinder-Klavier: Regenbogentasten und vier Instrumente.

apps.name: Pomodoro Desk Hub
apps.description: Smarte 7-Zoll-Schreibtisch-Dashboard: Pomodoro-Fokus-Timer, Monatskalender und gedimmter Nachtmodus.

apps.name: Puzzles
apps.author: Simon Tatham et al.
apps.description: Simon Tathams Sammlung: 40 Logikratsel (Bridges, Keen, Light Up, Loopy, Mines, Net, Solo...). Ruckgangig, Losung, gespeicherte Spiele. MIT.

apps.name: Schach
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Chess against the computer, powered by the mcu-max engine. You play white: tap a piece, then its square. Three levels, undo, check, mate and draw rules, and your game is saved.

apps.name: Timer
apps.description: Stoppuhr und Countdown mit Signalton. Grosse Ziffern.

apps.name: Vertice Bass
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Arcade-Angelturnier in 3D: sechs Seen, acht Arten, drei Koeder, Drills mit Schnurspannung und eine Rekordwand deiner zehn groessten Fische.
apps.notes: Boat you drive with the d-pad, lake select with unlocks, livewell scoring, harder fights, and key hints when a keyboard or gamepad is plugged in.

apps.name: Vertice GP
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: 3D-Kartrennen mit der Vertice-Engine: vier Karts, drei Runden, Drift-Turbo, Münzen und Windschatten. Touch, Tastatur oder Gamepad.

apps.name: Wetter
apps.description: Live-Wetter und Vorhersagen mit Open-Meteo, automatischer Standortbestimmung und Grafik-UI.

apps.name: Zigbee
apps.author: NucleoOS
apps.description: Zigbee2MQTT auf dem Panel: Gerate erscheinen von selbst; Lichter und Steckdosen schalten, Sensoren sehen. MQTT-Broker unter Einstellungen > Zuhause.

apps.name: Zork I-III
apps.author: Infocom / Microsoft; MojoZork by Ryan C. Gordon
apps.description: Zork I, II und III, die klassischen Textabenteuer von 1980 (englisch), frei unter MIT-Lizenz. zork im Terminal tippen, oder zork 2 fuer Zork II.

apps.name: BASIC
apps.author: Adam Dunkels (uBASIC), Nucleo port
apps.description: Klassisches zeilennummeriertes BASIC: print/if/goto/gosub/for-next/input. basic prog.bas tippen fuer ein Programm aus /sdcard/home. Kleingeschriebene Schluesselwoerter, Variablen a-z.

apps.name: bc calculator
apps.author: Gavin D. Howard and contributors
apps.description: bc, the arbitrary-precision calculator: numbers with as many digits as you want, functions, and a math library (bc -l). Type bc and write expressions like 2^200 or sqrt(2).

apps.name: Berry
apps.author: Guan Wenliang and the Berry contributors
apps.description: Berry, a small object-oriented scripting language for microcontrollers: interactive prompt and scripts. Type berry for the prompt, berry script.be to run a file from /sdcard/home.

apps.name: FIGlet
apps.author: Glenn Chappell, Ian Chai, John Cowan, Christiaan Keet, Claudio Matsuoka
apps.description: FIGlet writes text in big letters made of characters, with 15 built-in fonts. Type figlet Hello, or figlet -f slant Hello; figlet --list shows the fonts.

apps.name: Game Boy
apps.author: Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei, MiniGB APU by Alex Baines; NucleoOS
apps.description: Game Boy player (Peanut-GB, MIT): plays your own .gb games from /sdcard/home/roms with touch controls, gamepads, sound and battery saves. Homebrew: hh.gbdev.io.

apps.name: Glulxe
apps.author: Andrew Plotkin (Glulxe, CheapGlk)
apps.description: Moderne Textabenteuer (Inform 7 / Glulx) im Terminal. Eine .gblorb- oder .ulx-Geschichte nach /sdcard/home kopieren und glulxe geschichte.gblorb tippen.

apps.name: jq
apps.author: Stephen Dolan and the jq contributors (regex: Oniguruma, K. Kosako)
apps.description: jq, the command-line JSON processor: filter, transform and pretty-print JSON files, with regular expressions. Type jq '.name' data.json, or pipe JSON into it.

apps.name: JSON
apps.author: Dave Gamble and cJSON contributors
apps.description: JSON-Dateien validieren, formatieren, komprimieren, abfragen: cjson file.json, cjson -c file.json (kompakt), cjson -q .foo.bar file.json.

apps.name: Markdown
apps.author: Martin Mitá (md4c)
apps.description: Markdown zu HTML: md notes.md (HTML auf stdout), md -f -o out.html notes.md (vollstaendiges Dokument), md --gfm (GitHub-Tabellen/Durchgestrichen/Checklisten).

apps.name: pForth
apps.author: Phil Burk, Larry Polansky, David Rosenboom
apps.description: pForth, a portable ANS Forth: stack-based interactive programming, with floating point and file words. Type pforth for the prompt, pforth file.fth to load a file.

apps.name: Scheme
apps.author: Dimitrios Souflis, Kevin Cozens and the TinyScheme contributors
apps.description: TinyScheme, a small Scheme (R5RS subset): interactive prompt and scripts, with 64-bit integers, floats, strings, vectors and files. Type scheme for the prompt, scheme file.scm to run a file.

apps.name: Synth
apps.author: NucleoOS + AMY (Brian Whitman, Dan Ellis)
apps.description: Polyphonic synthesizer on the AMY engine: 128 Juno-106 and 128 DX7 patches plus a piano. Two-octave multi-touch keyboard, ten presets, volume, tone and reverb.

apps.name: Tcl
apps.author: Steve Bennett, Salvatore Sanfilippo and the Jim Tcl contributors
apps.description: Tcl in the Terminal (Jim Tcl): interactive prompt and scripts, with lists, dicts, regexp, OO and file I/O. Type tcl for the prompt, tcl script.tcl to run a file.

apps.name: Wren
apps.author: Robert Nystrom and the Wren contributors
apps.description: Wren, a small, fast class-based scripting language: interactive prompt and scripts, with a mini io module (Stdin, File). Type wren for the prompt, wren script.wren to run a file.

apps.name: Zip
apps.author: Rich Geldreich and contributors (miniz)
apps.description: Zip-Archive erstellen, auflisten, entpacken: zip archive.zip file1 file2 (erstellen), zip -l archive.zip (auflisten), zip -x archive.zip [Ordner] (entpacken).
